$comment: Machine-readable catalogue of accounting qualifications relevant to Pakistan. Companion to taxonomy/PROGRAMS_COMPLETE.md. DATA ONLY - no loader. All fee figures carry an explicit currency and as_of date; none are converted between currencies (see BLOCKERS-7.md B-011).

field_notes.relevance_pk: Agent 7 judgement of relevance to a Pakistani accounting learner: high | medium | low. The task brief listed EA and CFP as peers to CA; this catalogue disagrees and marks them low, with reasons.
field_notes.verification: tier_a = fetched from the awarding body this session; tier_c = triangulated secondary sources; not_verified = listed for completeness, figures not gathered.
field_notes.null_policy: null means NOT RESEARCHED or NOT PUBLISHED - it never means zero. Where a body does not publish a datum at all, published=false is stated explicitly.
field_notes.fees_policy: Fees are first-attempt, body-payable amounts only. They exclude books, coaching (except where mandatory and bundled), travel and retakes. ICMAP totals are modelled (Tier E) on Tier-A inputs.

qualifications.name: Chartered Management Accountant
qualifications.body: Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of Pakistan (ICMAP)

transparency.note: See BLOCKERS-7.md B-003 and B-007. Do not assert a 50% pass mark for Scheme-2025.

financial_aid.note: No published needs-based scheme located. Absence of evidence, stated as such.

qualifications.name: Chartered Accountant
qualifications.body: Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan (ICAP)

levels: CAF (8 papers, Groups A and B)

practical_training.note: 2.5-year uninterrupted route forbids sitting exams during training; 3-year post-CFAP route also available

schemes.name: Students Endowment Fund
schemes.criteria: merit gates; need assessed by Ihsan Trust

qualifications.name: ACCA Qualification
qualifications.pakistan_pricing_note: CONFIRMED: ACCA publishes the same GBP fees for Pakistan as globally. There is no regional discount.

levels: Applied Skills (LW, PM, TX, FR, AA, FM)

fees_gbp.exam_applied_knowledge_note: Set by CBE centres, not by ACCA. Not comparable across centres.
fees_gbp.modelled_total_note: Excludes Applied Knowledge exam fees. Exemptions do NOT save money: an Applied Skills exemption costs GBP 114 versus a GBP 160 exam.

currency_risk.reason: No Tier-A exchange rate captured. See BLOCKERS-7.md B-011.

transparency.key_finding: The difficulty cliff is at Applied Skills (BT 87% -> PM 40%), not at Strategic Professional. PM is harder than 4 of the 6 Strategic Professional papers. Rates are stable within +/-3 points across sessions, so a fixed per-paper prior is safe for BKT seeding.

practical_training.note: No stipend is mandated by ACCA; pay depends entirely on the student's own employment.

qualifications.name: Certified Management Accountant
qualifications.verification_note: No IMA page fetched this session. Triangulated across five secondary sources. See BLOCKERS-7.md B-012.

parts: Part 1: Financial Planning, Performance and Analytics

qualifications.entry_requirement: Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or a recognised professional certification
qualifications.entry_requirement_note: This CLOSES the IMA CMA to ICMAP's 12-year and 14-year entrants. The two qualifications are not open to the same population.

fees_usd.exam_per_part_student_note: NOT ASSERTED. Four sources give 370 / 407 / 415 / 480.26 - a 30% spread. See CONTRADICTIONS.md C-013.
fees_usd.confidence: moderate-high for professional rates (4-5 source agreement); rejected for student rates

practical_training.form: 2 continuous years in management accounting or financial management
practical_training.note: Satisfied by ordinary paid employment, completable before or up to 7 years after passing. Contrast ICMAP, where the student pays for training modules.

transparency.pass_rate_claim_note: Single unattributed secondary claim. NOT comparable to ACCA's published per-paper rates and must not be used to rank the two.

recognition: strong in US multinationals and GCC

qualifications.name: Cost and Management Accountant
qualifications.body: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
qualifications.warning: Dominates English-language search results for 'CMA fees'. Pollutes any un-scoped query. ICMAI is NOT ICMAP.

qualifications.name: Cost and Management Accountant
qualifications.body: Institute of Cost and Management Accountants of Bangladesh (ICMAB)
qualifications.note: Order of magnitude below ICMAP. Included as a regional cost benchmark, not as a route.

qualifications.name: Chartered Global Management Accountant / ACMA-FCMA
qualifications.warning: CIMA's 'Chartered Management Accountant' designation now COLLIDES with ICMAP's 2025 rebrand, while ICMAP simultaneously sells a CIMA conversion pathway.

qualifications.name: Public Finance Accountant
qualifications.body: Pakistan Institute of Public Finance Accountants
qualifications.note: ICAP cut the PIPFA exemption fee to PKR 7,400 in 2026, down 45% from 13,500. This makes PIPFA -> CA the cheapest documented laddered route into chartered status - a deliberate pro-domestic signal, given ICAP raised the ICAEW/ICAI/ICAS/CAANZ/CPA-Canada exemption 30% to PKR 200,500 in the same revision.

qualifications.name: Chartered Financial Analyst
qualifications.note: Investment management rather than accounting. Relevant to Track C (corporate finance / advisory) in taxonomy/SPECIALIZATIONS.md.

qualifications.name: Certified Public Accountant
qualifications.note: State-by-state eligibility rules make this materially harder for Pakistani candidates than headline comparisons suggest. Not researched in detail.

qualifications.name: Chartered Professional Accountant
qualifications.note: ICMAP prices a CPA Canada conversion route totalling PKR 164,600 - strong evidence of member demand to qualify abroad. See pakistan/BRAIN_DRAIN.md.

qualifications.name: Associate Chartered Accountant
qualifications.note: ICAP charges PKR 200,500 to exempt an ICAEW member - a 30% increase in 2026.

qualifications.name: Certified Internal Auditor
qualifications.note: Post-qualification specialisation rather than an entry route.

qualifications.name: Certified Fraud Examiner
qualifications.note: Forensic accounting. Demand in Pakistan is asserted in careers content but was not evidenced in this research.

qualifications.name: Enrolled Agent
qualifications.relevance_note: The task brief listed EA as a peer to CA. It is not. An EA is licensed to represent taxpayers before the US IRS. It has essentially no application to a Pakistani accountant working in Pakistan, beyond outsourcing roles serving US clients.

qualifications.name: Certified Financial Planner
qualifications.relevance_note: The task brief listed CFP as a peer to CA. It is a personal financial planning credential serving retail wealth management - a market that barely exists at scale in Pakistan. Low relevance.

brief_disagreements: The brief presented EA and CFP as peer qualifications to CA. This catalogue marks both low-relevance for Pakistan, with reasons stated in their relevance_note fields.
The brief's CA structure (AFC/CAF/CFAP+MSA) is obsolete under ICAP Education Scheme 2025. See CONTRADICTIONS.md C-011.
The brief's CMA cost of 'PKR 93,000 per module' conflates a 6-month LEVEL of three subjects with a single course. See CONTRADICTIONS.md C-004.
naming_collisions: Chartered Management Accountant: ICMAP (2025 rebrand) / CIMA (ACMA, FCMA)
ICMAP: also the International Class of Management and Accounting Program, Indonesia - a documented false positive in academic literature search
